TASK RECIPE:
# Cooking — Easy

## Capability dimension
Recipe-Order Memory and Thermal Response — Follow the cooking sequence and respond within the temperature window.

## Description
The drawer is preset open and no pot lid is required. All required portions must enter and remain in the pot. From the first attainment of 80 C, switch HEAT to KEEP WARM within 4 simulated seconds and at 80–90 C inclusive; confirm KEEP WARM for one simulated second before OFF, with no later overheating. Return empty jars upright to their original drawer slots and caps to the designated tray; both must be released, supported and stable at completion, with controls released. Stability is assessed over 0.5 simulated seconds. OFF freezes temperature; no cooling wait, re-capping or drawer closing is required.

## Scoring
100: Full success — all task requirements are satisfied.
Otherwise: 20 × k / 4 points (always below 20). The 4 required steps are: 2 ingredients poured in order, valid HEAT→KEEP_WARM, then OFF with jars and caps returned and released. Each food item, macaron, plate, ingredient or note counts as one step. k counts the required steps completed consecutively from the start, before the first error; a wrong, extra, invalid or out-of-order action stops the count.

Otherwise: 20 × k / 10 points (always below 20). ## Capability dimension
Timed reactive control — Respond to cues within a time limit.

## Description
Three buttons light up one at a time, 10 cues in total. For each cue, press the lit button within 4.0 simulated seconds and release it within 1 second after the press. 100: Full success — all 10 cues completed validly (this also means no unlit button was pressed).

Goal: Stand the dominos anywhere inside the continuous curve band, in order along the curve. Push the first one so the chain of contacts rings the bell. Repair fallen or stalled segments using as few pushes as possible.

Do not touch the bell, its clapper, or a domino while it is falling. Initial pushes and permitted restarts share the eight-push budget. A completed setup is a historical event: legal toppling does not invalidate it. Only evidenced legal activations and contact propagation count toward progress.

Scoring (highest eligible stage; stages are not added):

goals.easy:
Goal: Remember the four colored slots, observe the carousel rotation, then place each colored block into its original matching slot after the carousel stops.

TASK RECIPE:
# Carousel Colour Restoration — Easy

## Description
The four physical slots show colour cues for one simulated second. When the cues disappear, the carousel rotates through one or two segments in the same direction. Remember which colour belongs to each physical slot and track that slot through the rotation.

## Completion
Wait until the entire rotation program finishes, then place each coloured block in the physical slot that originally showed its colour, wherever that slot has moved. A momentary stop during reversal is not completion. Do not place any task block on the carousel before the program ends or move the carousel yourself; later correction cannot undo either violation. Holding a block while waiting is allowed. Afterwards, wrong-slot placements may be corrected. Success requires all four blocks simultaneously fully inside their matching slots, supported by the slot floors and released, with each position range below 3 mm relative to its slot throughout the final continuous simulated second. Resting on a rim does not count.

## Scoring
Full success scores 100; valid failures score 0, 5 or 10.
